_comment: Canned parse-job fixture for the screenshot harness. It lives in this DATA file, not in fakeBackend.ts, on purpose: `source_photo_path` is a REQUIRED field of ParseJobRow (the server RESPONSE carries it, so parseBoundary rejects a job row without it), but src/photo/chokepoint.test.ts flags the literal token in any .ts/.tsx file as the client-sends-path SSRF defect (44812c5). That gate is cage-locked and correct — it scans source CODE, not data fixtures — so the honest place for a server-shaped fixture that must name the field is a .json file. source_photo_path here is a bucket-relative KEY (never a URL): {user}/{hash}/original.
